content.text: : endocardial injury 🡪 focal adherence of platelets & fibrin 🡪 microorganisms circulating in blood infect platelet-fibrin nidus
mature vegetation is a collection of fibrin, platelets, leukocytes, RBC debris, & dense clusters of bacteria
S. aureus MCC, viridans strep, Enterococcus
: Chlamydia psittaci, the “ellas” (Bartonella, Legionella, Brucella, Coxiella), recent abx
: ↑ ESR, mild anemia, +RF, leukocytosis w/ left shift
degree AV block, BBB, complete heart block)
: different venipuncture sites, at least 1h between first & last, 3 sets ⊕>95% cases
(e.g., abscess, leaflet perforation, aortic pseudoaneurysm, fistula)
Empiric antibiotic therapy warranted for any patient w/ signs of
•persistent fever after 1wk suggests a septic embolic focus or inadequate coverage
•reappearance of fever after initial resolution suggests septic emboli or drug fever
